verdict.rationale: Docs mention plugin marketplaces provide 'version tracking' and 'versioned releases', and the API lets you specify an optional `version` for skill_id, implying some versioning support. However there is no documented review/approval workflow or explicit rollback mechanism — skills are just files/folders, so any versioning or rollback would rely on external git tooling not described as a first-class feature. missing for 10: explicit rollback command/feature, in-product review or approval workflow for skill changes, changelog/diff tooling, independent confirmation of version tracking in practice.
